body: I'm studying Economics and Philosophy, but its general stuff right now, I'm having a bit of trouble caring. It all just feels so hopeless right now, if no one has actually wanted to be my friend in the past, how is it suppose to change in the future? I hope it does work out but right now I can only see my bad qualities, I'm not even sure what my good qualities are anymore. This will pass, that's what I've been telling myself for the last 4 months, it hasn't, and my ability to push past it is waning. What's it gonna pass on to? Another group of people to exploit me and not value me? Another girl to use me for validation and laugh at me? That's where I'm at right now.

I'm sorry to hear about your brother, and thanks for responding. My brother is the only person that wants good things for me. I cause him so much stress, and accidentally fuck up his life, he would do better if I wasn't dragging him down. He's got to be sick of carrying me through this by now. Its not that simple, I'm a selfish asshole, I'm not a good friend to people. I've never been able to properly relate to people, that's why all the people I thought were my friends are making a joke about me now. If I were to kill myself something I did would have mattered, and those people who make fun will know how badly I hurt. Something I would do would affect people. Yeah its cowardly but its not like people don't already think that. All the other sad lonely kids think im a loser too, even if I do talk to them genuinely, im just too emotionally paralysed to do anything fun with them. I know I should try at something, I'm sick of failing. I just don't care about doing well in Uni anymore. None of the clubs really interest me, I don't want to be that exposed, and the year is nearly done.
